issues.description: Extraction requires data/stories/manifest.json and story files, but the repo contains an empty data/stories directory.
The advertised tiny end-to-end test fails on a clean checkout because required story fixtures are missing.
The documented tiny CPU demo does not run from the checked-in project state.
Tiny mode still unconditionally loads external story data instead of generating or bundling the deterministic tiny dataset.
Tiny extraction injects the ground-truth emotion label into activations, making demo validation partly self-fulfilling.
Generated demo artifacts are checked into the source tree, creating stale-output and review-noise risk.
Validation builds a backend from current CLI config without checking it matches the vector manifest backend, shape, or model.
Preference steering also trusts current CLI config over artifact metadata and can mix incompatible vectors and models.
Custom emotion sets with missing scenarios can produce empty stacks, missing diagonal entries, or unclear runtime failures.
The configured min_reported_emotions value is ignored and the code hard-codes four steered emotions.
Configuration exposes min_reported_emotions even though no code reads it.
HF auto loading defaults to full precision and whole-model .to(device), which is likely to OOM for the documented model.
Preference scoring compares only the first token of ' good' and ' bad', which is tokenizer-dependent and brittle.
Config values are coerced but not validated, so invalid topics, thresholds, token starts, or layer fractions fail late.
Activation-Elo correlation uses raw projection instead of normalized cosine, so activation norm can dominate the metric.
Tiny lexicon matching uses substring counts, allowing false-positive emotion signals from partial word matches.
Dependencies only use broad lower bounds, leaving reproducibility exposed to future incompatible releases.
